common_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE landscape 16:9 original painted dark-fantasy RPG EXPLORATION UI sample as a matching environment variant of the provided approved mine image. Keep its entire shared interface family closely consistent: exact iron/leather frame language and placement, modest ivory old-serif headings, readable text, ashen chart, dark leather header/footer, muted crimson selection/action, two whole portrait medallions and red HP. Preserve the same overall 70% map / 26% right destination inspector, supply rail and bottom company rail. This is ONE family, not a redesign. Change ONLY setting-specific chart artwork, place names/title, seal motif and selected-location vignette/copy. The chart must be a beautifully painted cartographic illustration with oblique architectural/landscape vignettes, NOT a tactical combat grid or free-walking scene. Keep small parchment location slips and six thin hand-inked paths. Seven locations at these positions: ENTRY left-middle, JUNCTION left-center-middle, UPPER_BRANCH center-upper, LOWER_BRANCH center-lower, GUARDIAN right-center-middle, EXIT far-right-middle, LOCKED far-right-upper. EXACT six intended links: ENTRY-JUNCTION, JUNCTION-UPPER_BRANCH, JUNCTION-LOWER_BRANCH, JUNCTION-GUARDIAN, GUARDIAN-EXIT, GUARDIAN-LOCKED. Clear pale current-location pin on ENTRY, crimson selected JUNCTION, restrained ivory emphasized ENTRY-JUNCTION path with small red directional marker, a lock on LOCKED. Avoid false links. Right inspector title is selected JUNCTION, descriptive illustration appropriate to that location, one short line of prose, 'From ENTRY' using the actual entry name, 'Light 4 > 3', 'Unexplored', primary muted-crimson 'Travel to room', secondary 'Back'. Top supply rail remains 'Light 4/4', 'Oil 2', 'Pick 1', 'Tools 1', 'Bandage 1', 'Camp 0', 'Food 1'; upper-right 'Return to Ravenford'. Keep SAME two portraits/identity/setting proportions from reference: Bran rugged bearded man 'HP 14/14', Torin hooded ranger 'HP 10/10', BOTH matching red health bars, all text readable and within frames. No extra heroes or systems. Palette and paint density must feel coherent with the mine reference; fine original material detail, quiet texture, no stretched grain, repeated squares, neon, emissive UI trim, flat wire boxes, giant labels hiding artwork, cartoon fantasy, asset-sheet layout, photoreal display mockup, logos or watermarks. The setting must be instantly recognizable, genuinely drawn for that archetype rather than a recolored mine. Finish as a complete crisp full-screen polished game UI concept.

variants.title: Blackbarrow
variants.detail: ARCHETYPE: STONE DUNGEON. Title 'Blackbarrow'. Replace all mine excavation/timber/ore imagery with ancient masonry dungeons: heavy barrel-vaulted stone passages, damp fitted blocks, stairs, prison cells, crypt doors, iron torch sconces, shallow black water. ENTRY 'Dungeon Stairs', selected JUNCTION 'Sentry Hall', UPPER_BRANCH 'Broken Vault', LOWER_BRANCH 'Flooded Cells', GUARDIAN 'Watch Post', EXIT 'Lower Gate', LOCKED 'Sealed Crypt'. Draw a dark stairwell entrance, a vaulted sentry hall, a collapsed masonry vault, drowned cells with corroded bars and a crypt door respectively; all seven have distinct readable vignettes. Small lantern-and-gate identity seal, no mining pickaxes or castle heraldic crown. Inspector line 'A silent hall beneath the old stone.' Materials cool worn gray parchment, cold ash/blue-gray masonry, small amber torches; original blood-red wax and iron frame remain same as approved reference. No skull overload, no bone clutter, no open castle courtyard or outdoor forest.

variants.title: Ravenkeep
variants.detail: ARCHETYPE: FORTIFIED CASTLE. Title 'Ravenkeep'. Replace cave chambers with an illustrated fortified stronghold: believable stone curtain walls, arched gatehouses, rain-wet courtyard flagstones, damaged Gothic chapel, barracks, great hall and watchtower. Show oblique painted architectural miniatures/cutaways on the ashen field chart. ENTRY 'Gatehouse', selected JUNCTION 'Outer Court', UPPER_BRANCH 'Ruined Chapel', LOWER_BRANCH 'Old Barracks', GUARDIAN 'Great Hall', EXIT 'Rear Gate', LOCKED 'Sealed Tower'. Connect these exact locations as specified in the shared topology; do not add decorative roads that invent extra graph links. Every location visually distinct: portcullis entrance, courtyard, ruined chapel window, soldiers' barracks, hall and sealed tower. Crenellated-tower seal replaces crossed mining tools. Inspector line 'Rain gathers between the old flagstones.' Same iron/leather/ivory/crimson UI as reference, cold gray stone and worn burgundy banners, tiny ember light. No mining tunnels, no mine tracks, no palace gold excess, no free-walk city screenshot, no tactical grid.

variants.title: Crowswood
variants.detail: ARCHETYPE: DARK FOREST. Title 'Crowswood'. Replace mine/castle masonry chart with a haunted woodland route chart: dense twisted old trees, exposed roots, wet leaf litter, tracks among foliage, mossy fallen stones, a small shrine, webbed grove, hunters' camp, rocky ridge and ancient sealed barrow. These are outdoor points of interest, not cave rooms painted green. The forest is under dense evening canopy; preserve readable medium-value moss/ash/olive-gray ground and the same muted dark-fantasy palette, not a nearly black image. ENTRY 'Forest Edge', selected JUNCTION 'Old Crossroads', UPPER_BRANCH 'Ruined Shrine', LOWER_BRANCH 'Spider Grove', GUARDIAN 'Hunters Camp', EXIT 'Ridge Path', LOCKED 'Sealed Barrow'. Connect exactly the shared six paths with readable winding cartographic trails, preserving distinct junction ownership. Inspector illustration is a woodland crossroads among roots, prose 'Old tracks vanish beneath the roots.' Thorn-and-leaf wax seal, no crossed pickaxes. Preserve shared iron/leather frame, typography, portraits and health. Restrained lichen accents on environment art, pale leaves/gray greens, only lantern/camp embers warm; no bright fairy forest, neon green, mushroom village, giant glowing runes, mine timbers or repeated trees.

edits.prompt: Edit this full landscape Ravenkeep castle UI concept. Change ONLY the SMALL round crimson wax seal hanging immediately below/right of the selected 'Outer Court' vignette near the left-center of the map. It currently contains crossed mining pickaxes. Replace just that little crossed-pickaxes emblem with a simple crenellated castle-tower emblem matching the tower identity already used in the large right-inspector wax seal and faded lower-right chart stamp. Keep the small seal's position, size, wax outline, shading and material. All other artwork and interface must remain unchanged: title Ravenkeep, all seven location labels, six paths, portraits, supplies, health values, text, inspector, frame layout, lighting, colors and castle buildings.
